benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card is a metal card co-branded with Times Internet Ltd. Catering to the lifestyle needs of the premium segment, the card lets the users elevate their lifestyle and travel experiences while availing exclusive services. At an annual fee of Rs. 20,000, it offers some high-end benefits like unlimited lounge access, milestone rewards worth up to Rs. 70,000, and other lifestyle benefits, including, but not limited to, the lifestyle management service called CribLife, exclusive access to events, dining discounts, and offers on travel and shopping. Though these features are expected from a high annual fee card, the major value back of this card comes from its annual and milestone benefits. Every year, card users can earn benefits up to Rs. 70,000 on meeting the spend threshold of up to Rs. 25 lakh. Though a decent value, the good part is the benefits are scattered around spend milestones ranging from Rs. 2 lakh to up to Rs. 25 lakh. That way, the card has something to offer to both moderate and high spenders. Even the joining and renewal perks on the card are good, covering some popular brands like Zomato and EaseMyTrip.

faqs.q: Does the Times Black ICICI Credit Card offer any airport lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes, Times Black ICICI Credit Card offers unlimited access to both domestic and international airport lounges.

faqs.q: What are the foreign transaction fees for the Times Black ICICI Credit Card?
faqs.a: Times Black ICICI Credit Card charges a foreign exchange transaction fee of 1.49% on all international spends.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the Times Black ICICI Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply online for Times Black ICICI Credit Card by visiting the official bank’s website. You can also contact your Relationship Manager in case you are an existing ICICI bank customer.

faqs.q: What are the key benefits of Times Black ICICI Credit Card?
faqs.a: Some of the key Times Black ICICI Credit Card benefits include up to 2.5% reward points earnings on card spends, unlimited access to airport lounges, milestone benefits worth up to Rs. 50,000, spend-based annual fee waiver, and other discount vouchers on top brands and experiences.

faqs.question: Is the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee is ₹20,000 + GST and the annual fee is ₹20,000 + GST. The annual fee is waived when you spend ₹25 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: It's 1.49% plus GST on spends in a foreign currency. That's lower than the usual 3.5%, which helps when you spend abroad.

faqs.question: Does the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card give airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get unlimited domestic visits, plus unlimited international visits.

faqs.question: How much can I earn with the Times Black ICICI Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn about 2% back in reward points on regular spends, and up to 2.5% on its bonus categories. Check the review above for the exact categories and monthly caps.
